items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: And when you all started working for Irving Mills, you say you all started working with Irving Mills when Duke Ellington and Cab Calloway were with him too. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, Cab Calloway and Duke worked for Mills.

ctx.x: This was after you got to New York.
Yeah. That's, you know, Duke -- Cab Calloway and Duke Ellington were working out of his office, Irving Mills.
Yeah, he lives in Hollywood or Beverly Hills, I think, now.
